description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time between two distinct categories, displaying a total of two slices. The larger segment, colored brown, is labeled "Reduction" and accounts for 60.9s, or 69.92% of the total. The smaller segment, colored dark blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" and represents 26.2s, or 30.08%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels, raw values in seconds, and corresponding percentages in parentheses are positioned directly on or adjacent to their respective slices. Visually, the "Efficient deployment" slice is emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the chart. The segments are visually arranged in descending order of size.
